author: "Andy Baxter"
format: html
---

```{r, setup}
#| echo: false
#| include: false

here::here("increasing_employment_rates.qmd")

library(reticulate)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

data <- readr::read_tsv(here("data/UK_2023_b1.txt"))

euromod <- import("euromod")

mod <- euromod$Model(here("UKMOD-PUBLIC-B2025.07"))
```

# Baseline runs

```{r, baseline-runs}
if (!dir.exists("output/baseline")) dir.create("output/baseline")

walk(2026:2029, \(year) {
  policy_system <- mod$countries['UK']$systems[glue::glue("UK_{year}")]
  policy_system$run(
    data,
    "UK_2023_b1.txt",
    outputpath = here("output/baseline")
  )
}, .progress = TRUE)
```

# Identifying employment statuses

```{r, employed-unemployed-subgroups}


# Employed group, for calculating hours and wages
sample_hours_wages <- data |>
  ## All employed
  filter(les == 3) |>
  ## Group ages and ethnicity_collapsed
  mutate(
    age_collapsed = case_when(
      dag >= 16 & dag < 25 ~ 1,
      dag >= 25 & dag < 31 ~ 2,
      dag >= 31 & dag < 51 ~ 3,
      dag >= 51 & dag < 56 ~ 4,
      dag >= 56 ~ 5
    ),
    ethnicity_collapsed = case_when(
      dot %in% 1:4 ~ "White",
      dot %in% 5:8 ~ "Mixed",
      dot %in% 9:13 ~ "Asian",
      dot %in% 14:16 ~ "Black",
      dot == 17 ~ "Other",
      .default = "Missing"
    ),
    dms_collapsed = case_when(
      dms == 1 ~ "single",
      dms == 2 ~ "married",
      dms %in% 3:5 ~ "separated",
      .default = "single"
    )
  ) |>
  ## Take median hours, mean wages, mean disposable income, weight by counts
  summarise(
    lhw = median(lhw),
    lhw00 = median(lhw00),
    yem = mean(yem),
    yds = mean(yds),
    n = n(),
  ## Group by age, gender, education, marital status, responsible for home,
  ## ethnicity_collapsed, caring responsibilities, industry
    .by = c(age_collapsed, dgn, deh, dms_collapsed, dhr, ethnicity_collapsed, lcr01, lindi)
  ) |>
  filter(lindi != -1, yem != 0, lhw != 0)


replacement_workers <- data |> 
  ## Select unemployed, inactive, sick or disabled, working age
  filter(les %in% c(5, 7, 8), dag %in% 16:64, !is.na(dag)) |> 
  mutate(
    age_collapsed = case_when(
      dag >= 16 & dag < 25 ~ 1,
      dag >= 25 & dag < 31 ~ 2,
      dag >= 31 & dag < 51 ~ 3,
      dag >= 51 & dag < 56 ~ 4,
      dag >= 56 ~ 5
    ),
    ethnicity_collapsed = case_when(
      dot %in% 1:4 ~ "White",
      dot %in% 5:8 ~ "Mixed",
      dot %in% 9:13 ~ "Asian",
      dot %in% 14:16 ~ "Black",
      dot == 17 ~ "Other",
      .default = "Missing"
    ),
    dms_collapsed = case_when(
      dms == 1 ~ "single",
      dms == 2 ~ "married",
      dms %in% 3:5 ~ "separated",
      .default = "single"
    )
  ) |>
  # Leave out variables to be imputed
  select(-lhw, -lhw00, -yem, -yds, -lindi) |> 
  left_join(
    sample_hours_wages,
    by = join_by(age_collapsed, dgn, deh, dms_collapsed, dhr, ethnicity_collapsed, lcr01)
    ) |> 
  replace_na(list(n = 1)) |> 
  slice_sample(by = idperson, n = 1, weight_by = n) |> 
  replace_na(
    list(lhw = median(sample_hours_wages$lhw),
         lhw00 = median(sample_hours_wages$lhw00),
         yem = median(sample_hours_wages$yem),
         yds = median(sample_hours_wages$yds),
         lindi = sample(sample_hours_wages$lindi, size = 1, prob = sample_hours_wages$n))
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    seeking = les == 5,
    sick_or_disabled = les == 8,
    under_25 = age_collapsed == 1,
    les = 3,
    ) |> 
  select(-n, -ethnicity_collapsed, -age_collapsed, -dms_collapsed)

```

## Create samples

```{r create-samples}

slice_weighted_sample <- function(data = replacement_workers, ..., prop = 0.05) {
  
  data |> 
    filter(...) |> 
    slice_sample(prop = 1) |> 
    mutate(.cum_dwt = cumsum(dwt)/sum(dwt)) |> 
    filter(.cum_dwt <= prop) |> 
    select(-.cum_dwt)
  
}

sample_workers_seeking <- replacement_workers |>
  slice_weighted_sample(seeking)

sample_workers_seeking_u25 <- replacement_workers |> 
  slice_weighted_sample(seeking, under_25)

sample_workers_seeking_o25 <- replacement_workers |> 
  slice_weighted_sample(seeking, !under_25)

sample_workers_sick_or_disabled_u25 <- replacement_workers |> 
  slice_weighted_sample(sick_or_disabled, under_25)

sample_workers_sick_or_disabled_o25 <- replacement_workers |> 
  slice_weighted_sample(sick_or_disabled, !under_25)

uprated_pop_5pc <- data |> 
  filter(!(idperson %in% sample_workers_seeking$idperson)) |> 
  bind_rows(sample_workers_seeking) |> 
  arrange(idhh, idperson)

uprated_seeking_u25_5pc <- data |> 
  filter(!(idperson %in% sample_workers_seeking_u25$idperson)) |> 
  bind_rows(sample_workers_seeking_u25) |> 
  arrange(idhh, idperson)

uprated_seeking_o25_5pc <- data |> 
  filter(!(idperson %in% sample_workers_seeking_o25$idperson)) |> 
  bind_rows(sample_workers_seeking_o25) |> 
  arrange(idhh, idperson)

uprated_sick_or_disabled_u25_5pc <- data |> 
  filter(!(idperson %in% sample_workers_sick_or_disabled_u25$idperson)) |> 
  bind_rows(sample_workers_sick_or_disabled_u25) |> 
  arrange(idhh, idperson)

uprated_sick_or_disabled_o25_5pc <- data |> 
  filter(!(idperson %in% sample_workers_sick_or_disabled_o25$idperson)) |> 
  bind_rows(sample_workers_sick_or_disabled_o25) |> 
  arrange(idhh, idperson)

write_tsv(uprated_pop_5pc, "data/updated_pop_5pc.txt")
write_tsv(uprated_pop_5pc, "data/updated_pop_seeking_u25_5pc.txt")
write_tsv(uprated_pop_5pc, "data/updated_pop_seeking_o25_5pc.txt")
write_tsv(uprated_pop_5pc, "data/updated_pop_sick_or_disabled_u25_5pc.txt")
write_tsv(uprated_pop_5pc, "data/updated_pop_sick_or_disabled_o25_5pc.txt")

```

# Run UKMOD for uprated pop

## 5% of all unemployed

```{r ukmod-uprated-pop-5pc}

data_5pc <- read_tsv(here("data/updated_pop_5pc.txt"))

if (!dir.exists("output/uprated_5pc")) dir.create("output/uprated_5pc")

walk(2026:2029, \(year) {
  policy_system <- mod$countries['UK']$systems[glue::glue("UK_{year}")]
  policy_system$run(
    data_5pc,
    "UK_2023_b1.txt",
    outputpath = here("output/uprated_5pc")
  )
}, .progress = TRUE)

```
